title: dalbergia kurzii
intro: Dalbergia kurzii, commonly known as Indian rosewood or kurz's rosewood, is a tree species native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dalbergia kurzii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
